αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
αἶψά: αἶψα — quickly, soon, at once; adv.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’ · also masc./neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, ’their’ (αὐτῶν τε φθογγήν ’their voice’, of the creatures on the far shore) · also gen. pl. ’our own’, possessive of the speaker’s group, with no other possessive (αὐτῶν … ἀφραδίῃσιν ’through our own follies’) · also masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of them’ (οὐδέ τις αὐτῶν ’not one of them’) · also masc. gen. pl. personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’)
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βεβήκει: βαίνω — go, walk, step; plpf. 3 sg. with simple past force (Homeric pluperfect): ’had gone, went’
βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
βλεφάροισιν: βλέφαρον — eyelid; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
βροτοῖσι: βροτός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
βρώμην: βρῶμη — food, eating; fem. acc. sg.
βρῶσίς: βρῶσις — food, eating; fem. nom. sg.
βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
βῆν: βαίνω — go, step; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβην)
γίγνονται: γίγνομαι — become, come into being; pres. 3 pl.: ’they come to be’ (of creatures that exist upon earth) · also with ἐκ: ’are born from, spring from’ (ἔκ τε κρηνέων … γίγνονται ’are born from springs’)
γίγνωσκον: γιγνώσκω — perceive, recognize, come to know; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγίγνωσκον): ’I perceived, I could tell’ · also impf. 3 pl. (same form), unaugmented: ’they recognised, they came to know’
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαστέρα: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γεγώνευν: γεγωνέω — shout, call out to; impf. 3 pl., epic uncontracted, unaugmented (= Attic ἐγεγώνουν)
γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
γλυκεροῖο: γλυκερός — sweet; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
γναμπτοῖς: γναμπτός — bent, curved; verbal adj. of γνάμπτω ’bend’; masc. dat. pl., agreeing with ἀγκίστροισιν: ’with bent hooks’
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δίπτυχα: δίπτυχος — twofold, double-folded; neut. acc. pl., predicative with ποιέω (δίπτυχα ποιήσαντες ’folding (it) double’)
δαίμων: δαίμων — a god, some divine power (vague, unspecified); masc. nom. sg.
δειλοῖσι: δειλός — wretched, miserable; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δηθὰ: δηθά — for a long time, long; adv.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’) · also with opt., of an aim in view: ’in case, to see if’ (εἴ τινά … λάβοι ’in case he might catch someone’) · also in ὡς εἴ τ’ + opt., ’as if’
εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I had’
εὐρέι: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic εὐρεῖ)
εὐρυμέτωποι: εὐρυμέτωπος — broad-browed; two-ending adj., fem. nom. pl., agreeing with βόες
εὐρύλοχ: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., elided (Εὐρύλοχ’ = Εὐρύλοχε)
εὐρύλοχος: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
εὐρὺν: εὐρύς — broad, wide; masc. acc. sg.
εὐχετόωντο: εὐχετάομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast; impf. 3 pl., epic diectasis (by-form of εὔχομαι)
εὔξαντο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
εὖρός: Εὖρος — the East Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg., accented εὖρός before a following enclitic (τε)
ζεφύροιο: Ζέφυρος — the West Wind, personified; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θέμενος: τίθημι — put, place; mid. also ’convene (an assembly)’; aor. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having convened’
θανέειν: θνῄσκω — die; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic θανεῖν)
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure) · also masc. gen. sg. used of a goddess (the masc. form serves either sex): θεοῦ εὐνήν ’a goddess’s bed’
θεσπεσίῃ: θεσπέσιος — wondrous, prodigious, superhuman in scale; fem. dat. sg. (ἠχῇ θεσπεσίῃ ’with a wondrous outcry’)
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θύελλα: θύελλα — storm-blast, squall, whirlwind; fem. nom. sg.
θῖνα: θίς — shore, beach; fem. acc. sg.
κάλυψε: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάλυψε)
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’)
κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κίρκη: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., address: ’Circe!’ (ὦ Κίρκη)
κακά: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’evils, troubles’ (πάθομεν κακά ’we suffered troubles’)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κακῆς: κακός — bad, evil, baneful; fem. gen. sg.
καλαὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. nom. pl.
καμάτῳ: κάματος — toil, weariness; masc. dat. sg.
καρτερὸν: καρτερός — strong, mighty, staunch; masc. acc. sg. (καρτερὸν ὅρκον ’a mighty oath’)
κατά: κατά — down, down from, throughout; prep. + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’); acute kept before an enclitic
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κε πίῃ) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever, as soon as’ (ὅτε … κε θάνῃσιν; ἐπεί κε … λίπῃ) · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κε … ἀκούσῃς) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κε λίσσηαι ’but if you beg’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: ’would have’ (καὶ νύ κε … βάλεν ’and she would have hurled’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κε θάνωμεν ’either we may die’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κιὼν: κίω — go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
κνίσῃ: κνῖσα (epic κνίση) — fat enveloping the entrails, savour of burning fat; fem. dat. sg.
κοῖλον: κοῖλος — hollow; masc. acc. sg. (κοῖλον λόχον ’the hollow ambush’, i.e. inside the wooden horse) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’hollow’ (κοῖλον σπέος)
κρῖ: κρῖ — barley (indeclinable form of κριθή); neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (indeclinable, same form), subject of an existential clause: κρῖ λευκόν ’white barley’ (understood ἔνι ’is in it’)
κυανοπρῴροιο: κυανόπρῳρος — dark-prowed; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with νεός
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λαίλαπι: λαῖλαψ — squall, whirlwind; fem. dat. sg.
λευκὸν: λευκός — white, bright; neut. acc. sg.
λιμός: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. nom. sg.
λιμῷ: λιμός — hunger, famine; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’by hunger’
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάλιστα: μάλα — very, much; superl. adv. μάλιστα: ’most of all, especially’
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέθυ: μέθυ — wine; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (identical form), subject of a passive verb (μέθυ πίνετο ’wine was drunk’)
μένοντες: μένω — remain, wait, stay; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’waiting’
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’)
μήδετο: μήδομαι — devise, plan, contrive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was devising, planned’
μίστυλλόν: μιστύλλω — cut into small pieces; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they cut into small pieces’
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῦνον: μοῦνος — alone, single (epic = Attic μόνος); masc. acc. sg.: ’alone’
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
μῆνα: μείς, μήν — month; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a month’
μῆρ: μηρός (pl. μῆρα) — thigh; sacrificial thigh-piece wrapped in fat and burned to a god; neut. acc. pl., elided (μῆρ’ = μῆρα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject, same form: ’the thigh-pieces’ (κατὰ μῆρ’ ἐκάη ’were burned’)
μῦθον: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; acc. sg. · also a plan, scheme agreed on (τοῖον...τελέωμεν μῦθον ’let us carry out this plan’)
νέεσθαι: νέομαι — go, return home; pres. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic νεῖσθαι)
νήδυμος: νήδυμος — sweet, refreshing (stock epithet of sleep; formation disputed, sometimes linked by folk-etymology to ἡδύς); masc. nom. sg.
νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
νεφεληγερέτα: νεφεληγερέτα — epithet of Zeus: ’cloud-gatherer’ (νεφέλη ’cloud’ + ἀγείρω ’gather’); masc. nom. sg., old -α form
νεὸς: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. sg., epic-Ionic (= Attic νεώς)
νηός: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic (= Attic νεώς)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νηῶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. gen. pl., epic νηῶν (= Attic νεῶν)
νιψάμενος: νίζω — wash; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having washed’
νυ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
νότος: Νότος — the South Wind, personified; masc. nom. sg.
νύκτα: νύξ — night; fem. acc. sg., accusative of duration: ’(through) the night’
νῆ: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα, elided (νῆ’ = νῆα)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἰμώξας: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having groaned’
οἰῶν: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., contracted (= epic ὀίων)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἴκτιστον: οἰκτρός — pitiable, piteous; superl. οἴκτιστος, neut. acc. sg., predicate: ’most pitiable’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
οὓς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. acc. pl.
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl. (elided πάντ’): ’everything’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντεσσι: πᾶς — all, every; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic πᾶσι)
πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they tasted’
πάσχοντες: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
πατρίδα: πατρίς — native land, fatherland; fem. acc. sg. (φίλην ... πατρίδα γαῖαν ’his dear fatherland’)
πειθώμεθα: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, + dat.; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us obey’
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
ποιήσαντες: ποιέω — make, do; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having made’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, perhaps’
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’) · also impf. 3 pl.: ’they addressed’ (ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδων)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’)
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. (distinct from πόσις ’drink’) · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πότμον: πότμος — fate, doom, death; masc. acc. sg.
πῇ: πῇ — where?, to what place?; interrog. adv.
σιδήρεα: σιδήρεος — of iron; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic σιδηρᾶ)
σκέπας: σκέπας — shelter, cover; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., ’shelter’ as goal of motion (ἐπὶ σκέπας)
σκύλλη: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea monster; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic Σκύλλα)
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by (+ gen.); adv. · also + dat.: σχεδὸν ἀλλήλῃσι ’close to one another’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build; pass. come to pass, happen; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, has come to pass’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; neut./masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg. (εἴ τιν’ … λύσιν ’some release’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl.: ’they’; also relative: ’who’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τρίχα: τρίχα — in three ways, threefold; adv.
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τἆλλα: ἄλλος — other; τἆλλα, crasis of τὰ ἄλλα: the rest, the other things; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ‘them, those’ (referring to ships) · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the mules · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the cattle · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the fruits · also fem. acc. pl. ’them’, of the nymphs and of the Sirens
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’) · also demonstrative, distributive: masc. acc. sg. ’the one … the other’ (τὸν μὲν … τὸν δ’) · also article-like with a participle: τὸν ἐόντα ’me, the one who am’
τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., + gen.: ’far from’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φίλας: φίλος — dear, own; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with the dual χεῖρε: ’dear (hands)’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, kin’ · also adjective, ’dear’, agreeing with ἑταίρους
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χαλεποί: χαλεπός — harsh, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
ἀέκητι: ἀέκητι — against the will of, in despite of; + gen.
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγκίστροισιν: ἄγκιστρον — fish-hook; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀγορὴν: ἀγορή — assembly, gathering place; acc. sg. (Ionic for Attic ἀγορά)
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀλάλησθαι: ἀλάομαι — wander; perf. inf., with perfect force shading to present: ’to be a wanderer, to go wandering’
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ἀμφ’ Ἄρεος φιλότητος ’about the love of Ares’) · also with ὀστεόφιν, ’around’ (ἀμφ’ ὀστεόφιν θὶς ’a heap around the bones’)
ἀμφιελίσσης: ἀμφιέλισσα — curved on both sides, well-rounded (of a ship; sense debated); fem. gen. sg.
ἀμφιρύτῃ: ἀμφίρυτος — sea-girt, flowed round on all sides; fem. dat. sg.
ἀνάγκῃ: ἀνάγκη — necessity, compulsion; dat. sg., dat. of manner: ’under compulsion’
ἀνέμοιο: ἄνεμος — wind; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀναβάντες: ἀναβαίνω — go up, go aboard, embark; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having embarked’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’) · also + acc., proportional, ’to, at the rate of’ (ἀνὰ εἴκοσι μέτρα ’at twenty measures (of water) to the one cup’) · also in tmesis with a verb of signalling, construed with a dat.: ἀνὰ … ὀφρύσι νεῦον ’I signalled with raised brows’ · also + acc. θυμόν, ’in (their) heart’ (ἀνὰ θυμὸν ἐθάμβεον ’they were amazed in their hearts’) · also + dat., ’on, upon’ (ἀνὰ φαιδίμῳ ὤμῳ ’on the shining shoulder’)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀφικοίμεθα: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 1 pl.
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄγετ: ἄγω — lead; pl. imper. ’come now!’, elided (ἄγετ’ = ἄγετε), addressed to a group
ἄγχ: ἄγχι — near, close by; adv., elided (ἄγχ’ = ἄγχι), also with a gen.: ’near him’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἅπαξ: ἅπαξ — once, a single time; adv.
ἐάᾳς: ἐάω — allow, leave alone; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ἐάᾳς (= Attic ἐᾷς)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκάη: καίω — burn; aor. pass. 3 sg., augmented (unaugmented κάη), in tmesis with κατά (κατὰ … ἐκάη = κατεκάη): ’was burned up, were burned up’ · also without preverb: ’burned’ (νεκρός τ’ ἐκάη ’the corpse burned’)
ἐκάλυψαν: καλύπτω — cover, wrap; aor. 3 pl., augmented (unaugmented κάλυψαν); in tmesis with κατά (κατά … ἐκάλυψαν = κατεκάλυψαν ’covered over’)
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνήσομεν: ἐνίημι — send into, launch into; fut. 1 pl., + dat.: ’we will launch (her) on’
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξέσσυτο: ἐκσεύομαι — rush out; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic σσ: ’rushed out’
ἐξέφθιτο: ἐκφθίνω — perish, be used up; aor. mid. 3 sg., epic root aorist with pluperfect sense: ’had run out’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπήλυθε: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon; aor. 3 sg., epic ἐπήλυθε (= Attic ἐπῆλθε)
ἐπακούει: ἐπακούω — listen to, overhear; pres. 3 sg.
ἐπεπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; plpf. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’was won over’
ἐπιβήμεναι: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on (+ gen.); aor. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐπιβῆναι)
ἐπισπεῖν: ἐφέπω — follow, meet, come upon (+ acc., of fate); aor. inf. ἐπισπεῖν
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐρυθρόν: ἐρυθρός — red; neut. acc. sg. (νέκταρ ἐρυθρόν ’red nectar’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun (οἶνον ἐρυθρόν ’red wine’)
ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl.
ἐυεργέα: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= ἐϋεργῆ)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐφορᾷ: ἐφοράω — look upon, oversee; pres. 3 sg.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc./neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὄντα)
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑλοῦσα: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg., unaugmented: ’having taken’
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔειπον: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 1 sg., epic ἔειπον (= Attic εἶπον)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may come’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστιν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also plain copula, personal: ’is’ (ἀργύρεος ... ἔστιν ἅπας ’it is entirely silver’) · also with a dat. of the possessor, ’have’ (ἅσσα μοι ἔστιν ’whatever I have’)
ἔτειρε: τείρω — wear away, distress, afflict; impf. 3 sg., augmented
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχευαν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 pl., epic -αν (= Attic ἔχεαν)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’I had, I was carrying’
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
ἠέ: ἠέ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic = ἤ), esp. in ἠέ ... ἦ ’either... or’
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠελίου: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. gen. sg.
ἠελίῳ: ἥλιος — sun; masc. dat. sg., epic ἠέλιος (= Attic ἥλιος)
ἠεροειδέι: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dusky; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with πόντῳ
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἤια: ἤια — provisions for a journey; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl. (subject): ’our stores’ · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἦα: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἦα (= Attic ἦν)
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’ · also ’until’ + optative, of an expected end (ἧος θερμαίνοιτο ’until it should grow hot’)
ἰθάκην: Ἰθάκη — Ithaca, Odysseus’ island home; acc. sg.
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish/potential: ’might come, may he reach’
ὀβελοῖσιν: ὀβελός — spit; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀδυσεῦ: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; masc. voc. sg., single-σ form (Attic Ὀδυσσεῦ)
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; (intrans.) arise, spring up; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had sprung up’
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁμοῦ: ὁμοῦ — together, together with, at the same place; adv.
ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη) · also neut. acc. sg. relative, referring back to a thing, object of δῶκας: ’which (you gave me)’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place (distinct from ὅτε ’when’, similarly elided ὅτ’) · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — when; temporal conj.: ὅθ’ ἑὸς δόμος ἀμφεκάλυψε ’when his own house sheltered (me)’
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὑπερίονι: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun; masc. dat. sg., in apposition with Ἠελίῳ
ὕπνῳ: ὕπνος — sleep; masc. dat. sg. (ὕπνῳ γλυκερῷ ’sweet sleep’)
ὠμοθέτησαν: ὠμοθετέω — lay raw pieces (on the burning offering) (ὠμός ’raw’ + τίθημι ’place’); aor. 3 pl.: ’they laid raw pieces’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥέξομεν: ῥέζω — do, perform, offer (sacrifice); fut. 1 pl., epic: ’we will offer’
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
